title: Design System: Libot Bulacan Super Admin Console

display.purpose: Page title in the band. 29px under 720px.

numeral.purpose: Stat-strip numbers and the health panel's ping figure. 28px under 720px.

brand.purpose: The rail's Libot Bulacan wordmark; avatar initials at 14px.

strip-word.purpose: A word in a stat cell (a state, a username). Never Knewave.

body.purpose: Rows, links, menus. Dongle loads with size-adjust 172%, ascent 55.8%, descent 15.1%, line-gap 0 (x-height 0.30 em vs Schibsted 0.53, measured in Edge).

label.purpose: Table column heads and filter-group heads on ink.

mono.purpose: Times, IDs and measurements wherever they appear.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Ctrl K jump dialog and profile dialog.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: The rail as a phone drawer (under 720px) only.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Rail fold (0.2s), drawer slide (0.24s), switch thumb (0.2s), menu and dialog entrance (0.16 to 0.18s, 4px rise and fade).

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Background, colour and border changes on rail links, icon buttons, strip cells and the jump field.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion the rail, menus, dialogs, backdrop and switch thumb do not animate.

components.css: .ds-band { background: #0C2A2D; color: #EAF4F2; border-radius: 14px; padding: 22px 24px 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; font-family: 'Dongle Libot', 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-band-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Knewave Libot', 'Dongle Libot', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 36px; line-height: 1.02; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.005em; } .ds-band-live { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 16px; color: #A9C4C1; } .ds-band-live b { color: #EAF4F2; } .ds-mono { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1px; background: rgba(234,244,242,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(234,244,242,0.12); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 13px 15px 12px; background: #0C2A2D; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease; } a.ds-cell:hover { background: #143A3E; } a.ds-cell:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F2CE1B; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-cell-label { display: flex; gap: 7px; align-items: flex-start; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.2; color: #A9C4C1; } .ds-swatch { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; margin-top: 3px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-cell-value { font-family: 'Knewave Libot', 'Dongle Libot', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 34px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-cell-value.ds-word { font-family: 'Dongle Libot', 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 25px; line-height: 1.05; padding-top: 4px; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-good { color: #5FD69A; } .ds-cell-hint { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.25; color: #86A6A3; }

components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--card-bg, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--border, #D3DEDB); border-radius: 14px; color: var(--text-primary, #0F2120); font-family: 'Dongle Libot', 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider, #E1E9E6); } .ds-panel-head.ds-ink { background: #0C2A2D; color: #DCEBE8; border-bottom: none; border-radius: 13px 13px 0 0; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-panel-link { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--brand, #0A6F78); text-decoration: none; } .ds-ink .ds-panel-link { color: #EAF4F2; } .ds-panel-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-panel-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F2CE1B; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-rows li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 78px 1fr max-content; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 9px 16px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-rows li + li { border-top: 1px solid var(--divider, #E1E9E6); } .ds-mono { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text-muted, #4F6563); } .ds-what { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-swatch { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-who { color: var(--text-muted, #4F6563); }

components.css: .ds-rail { width: 256px; padding: 0 10px 12px; background: #0C2A2D; color: #EAF4F2; font-family: 'Dongle Libot', 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 16px 8px 14px; font-family: 'Knewave Libot', 'Dongle Libot', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-brand small { font-family: 'Dongle Libot', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #A9C4C1; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-jump { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(234,244,242,0.12); border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.12); color: #A9C4C1; font: inherit; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-jump:hover { border-color: rgba(234,244,242,0.30); color: #EAF4F2; } .ds-jump kbd { margin-left: auto; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; padding: 1px 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(234,244,242,0.30); border-radius: 5px; } .ds-group { padding: 12px 10px 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #86A6A3; } .ds-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; min-height: 40px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 9px; color: #A9C4C1; font-size: 16px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-link:hover { background: #143A3E; color: #EAF4F2; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F2CE1B; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-link[aria-current='page'] { background: #1D4A4F; color: #EAF4F2; font-weight: 700; } .ds-link[aria-current='page'] svg { color: #F2CE1B; } .ds-count { margin-left: auto; min-width: 22px; height: 20px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #F2CE1B; color: #2C2810; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 46px; height: 26px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: #7D8F8D; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease; } .ds-switch::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-switch[aria-checked='true'] { background: var(--success, #16764F); } .ds-switch[aria-checked='true']::after { transform: translateX(20px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #0A6F78); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The super admin console is the development team's control room, read through the day and on a projector at the thesis defense. It wraps full-width pages in deep river-teal ink: the rail, the top bar, every page's opening band and every table head share that one ink, so the frame reads as one instrument. Content sits on pale sage paper in white panels with hairline borders and no shadows. Density is high and deliberate: dense tables, stat strips, a live health panel, small multiples of the usage charts.

The system's spine is its series hues. Each kind of thing (travelers, reviews, accounts, tickets, the system, spot arrivals) owns one validated hue, and that hue comes back everywhere the thing appears: the swatch beside a stat-strip label, the bars of its chart, the tag in the activity feed, its segment of the activity-mix bar. A page's stat strip is therefore also the legend for that page. Text never wears a series hue; a swatch beside the words carries the identity.

Type is loud at the top and quiet below. Knewave, a brush display face, sets page titles, the brand and big numerals only; Dongle, size-adjusted to read like a normal UI sans, sets every other word; monospace carries times, IDs and measurements. Libot yellow is the one primary action on any screen. The console refuses both the cream single-teal admin page and the generic navy dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Ink frame (rail, top bar, page band, table heads) around sage paper and white panels.
Six validated series hues plus slate, one per kind of thing, identical in strip, chart, tag and mix bar.
Knewave for titles, brand and numerals; Dongle for words; monospace for times, IDs and measurements.
Flat panels with hairlines; only menus and dialogs float.
Full width, no max-width; panels in a two-column split that collapses in priority order.
Light and dark themes, both holding WCAG AA on every text pair.

rules.name: The Legend Rule
rules.body: A thing's hue is the same in the stat strip, its chart, its tag and the activity-mix bar. A page's strip is that page's legend; never assign a hue to a thing that already owns another.

rules.name: The Swatch Not Text Rule
rules.body: Series hues mark swatches, bars and segments. Words stay in the text ladder.

rules.name: The Teal Next To Blue Rule
rules.body: Series blue and series teal fail the normal-vision separation floor side by side (ΔE 13.5). Stacked or adjacent marks never put them next to each other. The activity mix stacks sign-ins slate, accounts blue, tickets marigold, travelers teal, system violet, an order that passes.

rules.name: The State Is Not A Series Rule
rules.body: Success, warning and danger are separate from the six series hues and always arrive with an icon and a word, never colour alone.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Libot yellow with on-yellow text is the one primary action per screen.

rules.name: The Knewave Is For Numbers Rule
rules.body: Knewave sets page titles, the brand and numerals only. A word in the stat strip is Dongle 700, never Knewave.

rules.name: The Measured Things Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Times, IDs and measurements are monospace wherever they appear: band live line, activity times, health facts, ticket and log tables, "Signed in 30 min ago".

rules.name: The Only Floating Things Float Rule
rules.body: No shadow on panels, cards, the band or tables. Menus, dialogs and the phone drawer are the only shadowed surfaces.

dos: Do open every super admin page with the band and, where a page has figures, a stat strip whose swatches key that page's charts and tags.
Do give each kind of thing its one series hue everywhere: teal travelers, orange reviews, blue accounts, marigold tickets, violet system, magenta arrivals, slate sign-ins.
Do use the dark (`-dark`) series steps for swatches on the ink band and for marks in the dark theme.
Do set times, IDs and measurements in monospace with tabular figures.
Do give live lists and tables an ink panel head and forms, charts and notes a plain white head.
Do divide rows inside a panel with divider hairlines.
Do pair every status colour with an icon and a word.
Do keep Dongle's size-adjust (172%) and its divided metric overrides whenever the face is loaded.
Do scope every rule under `:root[data-console='superadmin']`, and write no colour in a component; use the tokens.
donts: Don't set a word in Knewave; it is for page titles, the brand and numerals.
Don't put series blue next to series teal in stacked or adjacent marks.
Don't colour text with a series hue, or use a series hue to signal a state.
Don't add a second yellow button to a screen, or use yellow beyond the primary action, count badges, the avatar and the current rail icon.
Don't put shadows on panels, the band or tables; only menus, dialogs and the phone drawer float.
Don't box rows inside a panel as nested cards.
Don't draw a spark from made-up data; sparks show real daily series only.
